name: Honeyberry
grown_as: A hardy fruit bush (also called haskap or blue honeysuckle). William grows one listed as 'Kamtschatica' (Lonicera caerulea var. kamtschatica) and one of unknown variety. Two are needed for pollination.
habit: A compact, upright, rounded deciduous shrub, 1 to 1.5 m. Older stems with light brown bark peeling in long strips; young shoots reddish-purple.

leaf.outline: Oblong to elliptic, 3 to 7 cm long
leaf.tip: Blunt to rounded, sometimes a small point
leaf.margin: Smooth, with a fringe of fine hairs
leaf.veins: A midrib and a few faint side veins
leaf.colour: Grey-green to mid green; yellow in autumn

flower.form: A narrow funnel opening into five near-equal lobes
flower.petals: Five, joined into the funnel, the lobes short and spreading
flower.centre: Five stamens and a style poking just beyond the mouth
flower.behind: Small bracts; the two flowers of a pair share joined ovaries
flower.carried: In pairs, side by side, from the angle of each leaf pair on short stalks, hanging or angled downward
flower.season: February to April, among the first flowers of spring and frost-proof

fruit: An oblong, slightly cylindrical berry, 1.5 to 2.5 cm, dark blue with a pale grey-blue bloom, often a little angled or kinked, formed from the two joined ovaries of a pair of flowers. Hangs singly from the leaf angles. May to June, the earliest fruit of the garden.
seedling: Not drawn: grown as bought plants
winter: Bare, upright stems with light brown peeling bark and small paired buds.

palette_wish.fruit: dusky blue under a grey-blue bloom, about #4E6390

leaf: simple oblong leaf with a smooth edge
blunt rounded tip and rounded base
bloom: a pale creamy-yellow funnel flower with five short spreading lobes
a second flower beside it as a pair
dormant: light brown bark peeling in strips
flower: pairs of pale yellow funnel flowers hanging from the leaf pairs
crop: long oval blue berries with a pale bloom hanging singly

look_alikes: Blueberry has alternate leaves, white urn flowers and round berries with a crown. Other shrubby honeysuckles (such as Lonicera fragrantissima) have white winter flowers and red berries. Snowberry has pink bell flowers and white berries.
